studio.ed.sc.single: One background for the whole reel. Tap + in the timeline to add more scenes.
studio.ed.q1080: Best for Instagram, TikTok and Shorts
studio.ed.noExport: This browser cannot export video (no WebCodecs). Try Chrome on Android or desktop.

studio.ed.exportUnsupported: Export is not supported in this browser
